name: worktreeguard-codex
description: Codex hooks and a bundled local command for WorktreeGuard-managed Git worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex writes out of protected base checkouts.
interface.longDescription: Installs Codex lifecycle hooks plus a bundled local WorktreeGuard command so protected base checkouts deny mutating tool calls, guide agents to use native Git worktrees, and honor human-approved base access grants.
defaultPrompt: Use WorktreeGuard before editing this repo.
